Fever Purge.name: Fever Purge
Fever Purge.description: The user holds a patient's wrist and drives their body's defenses into a fever that burns out a poison, a venom, a knockout gas, a drug or a fresh infection. Its effects end at once, including the frenzy of a Quirk-boosting drug, and the patient loses heavy stamina and runs a fever for about an hour. Strain: moderate.
